source.author: lucan
source.text: Mons inter geminas medius se porrigit undas Inferni superique maris: collesque coercent Hinc Tyrrhena vado frangentes aequora Pisae, Illinc Dalmaticis obnoxia fluctibus Ancon.
source.text_original: Mons inter geminas medius se porrigit undas / Inferni superique maris: collesque coercent / Hinc Tyrrhena vado frangentes aequora Pisae, / Illinc Dalmaticis obnoxia fluctibus Ancon.
source.text_english: A mountain stretches itself between the twin waters, midway between the sea below and the sea above: and hills confine it—Pisae here, breaking the Tyrrhenian waves at a shoal, and Ancon there, exposed to the Dalmatian floods.

reuse.author: val
reuse.text: aequore Trinacrio refugique a parte Pelori stat rupes horrenda fretis: quot in aethera surgit molibus, infernas totidem demissa sub undas.
reuse.text_original: aequore Trinacrio refugique a parte Pelori / stat rupes horrenda fretis: quot in aethera surgit / molibus, infernas totidem demissa sub undas.
reuse.text_english: On the Trinacrian sea and on the side of retreating Pelorus there stands a terrifying rock amid the straits: as many masses as it rises into the air, so many it plunges down beneath the lower waves.
